messages:
sara: Hey team, getting an urgent customer escalation — hosted API returning a burst of 502s during streaming calls to model endpoint. Customer says it started after a heavy long-poll stream (~30s). Trace IDs: trace=tr-9a8b7c6d, tr-7c6d5b4a. They see: 

  - client gets HTTP/2 RST_STREAM, then immediate 502s from gateway
  - nginx/edge logs show upstream reset on stream id=5 and 'upstream prematurely closed connection'

  Repro steps I have so far: 
  1) curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' --http2 "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-xl" 
  2) send a ~20k tokens prompt in chunks, keep streaming open ~20-40s

  Any quick triage pointers? Customer on hosted Dedicated, region us-west-2. :rotating_light:

ben: Ack. Can you paste the gateway logs and a sample edge trace? Also which customer tenant id?

sara: Tenant: tenant-acme-42. Attaching snippet from edge (redacted):

  [edge][2025-05-18T14:02:13.123Z] trace=tr-9a8b7c6d conn=gw-23 stream=5 upstream=ingress-proxy-7 status=502 reason=RST_STREAM reset_reason=STREAM_CANCELLED details=\"upstream reset writing response body\"
  [auth][2025-05-18T14:02:12.980Z] token_verifier: cache_miss tenant=tenant-acme-42 key=auth:tenant-acme-42:token-XXXX
  [auth][2025-05-18T14:02:13.001Z] token_verifier: cache_set ttl=15s tenant=tenant-acme-42
  [edge][2025-05-18T14:02:13.120Z] stream=5 write_err EPIPE while writing to client

  Note: auth cache_set TTL looks short (15s) in these logs.

casey: Interesting — sounds like an auth-cache TTL race together with h2 window/corking on long streaming responses. We recently rolled a small change to auth cache to aggressively TTL tokens at 15s when backend returned soft-expiry; that makes the token verification path do a cache_miss+refresh mid-stream if a background token refresh happens. When the auth path blocks (KV lookup / tenant lookup), the ingress proxy can stall the h2 stream, causing upstream write timeouts and RSTs.

rachel: Repro'd locally with a synthetic stream (wrk + http2) — if token cache invalidates during a chunked response, ingress blocks while waiting for auth validation and the write window drains, then nginx emits RST_STREAM -> 502 on the client.

ben: Great repro. Two actionable fixes: 
  1) Short-term mitigation: bump auth cache TTL for tenant tokens to 60s for hosted infra and enable a fast-path skip-if-inflight flag so concurrent checks return cached in-progress state. 
  2) Medium-term: make auth verification asynchronous for in-flight streams — allow request to continue while we validate token for subsequent requests, with fallback to immediate drop only if token invalid. Also add a guarding circuit in edge to avoid blocking on auth backend more than X ms when the connection is mid-stream.

casey: For immediate customer workaround I can: 
  - patch config to set auth.cache.default_ttl=60s in edge-config for hosted region us-west-2 (non-prod patch test first)
  - add a quick guard: edge.ingress.auth_deadline_ms=200 (if auth doesn't respond within 200ms, allow transparent pass-through and mark audit event)

sara: Customer wants ETA — can we get hotfix timeline?

casey: I'll roll the TTL bump to canary within 30m, monitor trace error rate and h2 RSTs. If canary looks good, promote to region in 2h. Will also toggle a feature-flag for in-flight skip.

ben: I'll prepare a rollback plan and add a metric alert: edge.auth.response_time.p50/p95 and edge.streams.reset_rate. Also add a temporary log sampling increase for trace=tr-9a8b7c6d family.

infra-bot: Deploy started: edge-config-canary -> canary1 (us-west-2). Change: auth.cache.default_ttl from 15s -> 60s. CI tests passed.

rachel: Canary looks promising. Reset rate for tr-9a8b7c6d families dropped from 3.2% -> 0.4% in first 10m. No increase in auth backend QPS.

sara: Customer notified that we're rolling mitigations; asking them to validate streaming after 45m. They appreciate fast response. :white_check_mark:

ben: Follow-ups: add test for long-lived streaming with mid-stream auth cache eviction in e2e suite, and ensure config defaults are safer. I'll file a ticket for making auth validation async.

casey: Filed INF-1219 "auth cache ttl race causing h2 corking -> 502" with repro steps + canary results.

sara: Closing loop once customer confirms. Thanks everyone.
